result.citation_basis: § 218-12 and Ord. 25-057: D035; subsection 2 numbered 1 and 2 (the rule and the service-provider ban): O082 (Ord. 25-076); Enforcement renumbered from 3 to 4 (reporting 3.a.i.1, private action 3.b, penalties 3.c.i in D035): O083 (Ord. 25-098)
result.official_quote:
It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or 
otherwise exchange anything of value in return for or otherwise utilize the services of a Service 
Provider.
result.note: Added the pinpoint to the unlawful-conduct subsection and the two amending ordinances: Ord. 25-076 (O082) renumbered subsection 2's items as 1 and 2 and added 'or otherwise utilize', and Ord. 25-098 (O083) inserted a new subsection 3 and moved Enforcement to 4. The card's quote from D035 is Ord. 25-057's original wording, now superseded, so the quote is taken from O082. The Municode code (O084, Apr. 3, 2026) still shows § 218-12 as 'Exempt dwellings' and lists 25-057 and 25-098 as pending amendments, so this section is not yet codified there. D002 is a law-firm alert, not law text.
